_comment: Starter catalogue. Prices are placeholders in ZAR (VAT-inclusive) — confirm with the client before launch. Tags drive the smart collections; 'live-plant' drives the dispatch notice.

collections.title: All live plants
collections.description: Every carnivorous plant in the nursery, grown on rainwater and ready to ship.

collections.title: Beginner-friendly plants
collections.description: Forgiving, fast-growing carnivores that thrive on a sunny windowsill or patio. The best place to start.

collections.title: Venus flytraps
collections.description: Dionaea muscipula — the snap-trap icon. Full sun, rainwater and a cool winter rest are all they ask.

collections.title: Sundews
collections.description: Drosera — glittering sticky tentacles that curl around their prey. Several of the world's best beginner sundews are South African.

collections.title: Trumpet pitchers
collections.description: Sarracenia — tall, veined pitchers for sunny patios and bog gardens. Hardy, dramatic and hungry.

collections.title: Tropical pitchers
collections.description: Nepenthes — hanging pitchers from the tropics. Bright indirect light, humidity and no winter rest.

collections.title: Butterworts
collections.description: Pinguicula — jewel-like rosettes with greasy leaves that trap fungus gnats. Superb on a windowsill.

collections.title: Bladderworts
collections.description: Utricularia — tiny underground vacuum traps and flowers that steal the show.

collections.title: Collector's corner
collections.description: Rare and demanding species for experienced growers with terrariums or greenhouses.

collections.title: South African natives
collections.description: Carnivores that grow wild in South Africa — nursery-propagated, never collected from the wild.

collections.title: Growing supplies
collections.description: Mineral-free soil, pots and kits — everything a carnivore needs, nothing it doesn't.

products.title: Venus Flytrap
products.description: The classic. Rows of bristled traps snap shut in a fraction of a second when an insect brushes the trigger hairs twice. Nursery-grown on rainwater and hardened outdoors, so it's ready for a sunny South African windowsill or patio.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Stand the pot in 1–2 cm of water in spring and summer.
plant.dormancy: Required — cool winter rest, roughly Jun–Aug

products.title: Venus Flytrap 'B52'
products.description: A giant-trap cultivar selected for traps that can exceed 4 cm on mature plants. Vigorous and forgiving — a great upgrade once your first flytrap is thriving.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Tray method in the growing season.
plant.dormancy: Required — cool winter rest, roughly Jun–Aug

products.title: Venus Flytrap 'Akai Ryu'
products.description: 'Red Dragon' — every leaf and trap turns deep burgundy in strong sun. A little slower than green forms, and stunning next to them.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Tray method in the growing season.
plant.dormancy: Required — cool winter rest, roughly Jun–Aug

products.title: Cape Sundew
products.description: A South African native and arguably the easiest carnivore in the world. Strap-like leaves glitter with sticky dew and slowly curl around gnats. Flowers freely and self-seeds.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Keep the soil constantly moist.

products.title: Cape Sundew 'Alba'
products.description: The white-flowered form of the Cape sundew, with pale green leaves and crystal-clear dew. Just as tough as the classic.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Keep the soil constantly moist.

products.title: Alice Sundew
products.description: A flat rosette of red-tipped, dew-covered leaves from the Cape. Compact enough for the smallest windowsill, and it colours up beautifully in sun.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Tray method.

products.title: Lance-leaf Sundew
products.description: Long, lance-shaped leaves and sprays of tiny red flowers. Happiest in a humid terrarium or a bright bathroom out of direct sun.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Keep moist, never waterlogged.
plant.soil: Peat, perlite and a little sphagnum.

products.title: Purple Pitcher Plant
products.description: Squat, rain-filled pitchers veined in purple, sitting in a rosette. The toughest Sarracenia — ideal for a sunny patio bog.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Stand in 2–3 cm of water all summer.
plant.dormancy: Required — cool winter rest, roughly Jun–Aug

products.title: White Trumpet Pitcher
products.description: Tall pitchers with lacy white tops veined in red — one of the most striking plants in the nursery. Needs full sun to colour well.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Tray method.
plant.dormancy: Required — cool winter rest, roughly Jun–Aug

products.title: Trumpet Pitcher 'Juthatip Soper'
products.description: A vigorous hybrid with deep red, heavily veined pitchers. Hybrid vigour makes it one of the easiest trumpet pitchers to grow well.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Tray method.
plant.dormancy: Required — cool winter rest, roughly Jun–Aug

products.title: Tropical Pitcher Plant
products.description: The most forgiving Nepenthes: green-and-red pitchers dangle from the leaf tips. Grow it in a hanging basket by a bright window — no winter rest needed.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water. Water from the top when the surface starts to dry — don't stand in water.
plant.soil: Sphagnum moss, perlite and orchid bark.

products.title: Tropical Pitcher 'Miranda'
products.description: A big, vigorous hybrid with speckled pitchers that can reach 25 cm on mature plants. Give it space and bright light.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water. Water from the top; keep lightly moist.
plant.soil: Sphagnum moss, perlite and orchid bark.

products.title: Mexican Butterwort 'Tina'
products.description: Glossy rosettes that quietly clear fungus gnats from your houseplants, plus long-lasting pink flowers. A near-indestructible windowsill plant.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water. Moist in summer; keep drier in winter.
plant.soil: Gritty mix: perlite, sand and a little peat.
plant.dormancy: Succulent winter rosette — water sparingly Jun–Aug

products.title: Rabbit-ears Bladderwort
products.description: A South African native famous for its tiny white flowers that look exactly like bunny faces. The traps are microscopic bladders hidden under the soil.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Keep very wet — stand in water.

products.title: Albany Pitcher Plant
products.description: Tiny, hairy, toothed pitchers from a single corner of south-western Australia. Slow, rewarding and a true collector's plant.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water. Moist but airy — never waterlogged.
plant.soil: Peat, perlite and sand in a deep pot.

products.title: Sun Pitcher
products.description: A pitcher plant from the misty tabletop mountains of Venezuela. Needs cool nights, strong light and high humidity — a terrarium project for experienced growers.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water. Water from the top often.
plant.soil: Live sphagnum over peat and perlite.

products.title: Carnivore Soil Mix
products.description: Our house mix of sphagnum peat and horticultural perlite — mineral-free, fertiliser-free and ready to use. Suits flytraps, sundews, trumpet pitchers and butterworts (add extra perlite for butterworts).

products.title: Nursery Pots — 10 pack
products.description: Deep plastic pots with generous drainage holes, sized for repotting carnivores. Plastic won't leach minerals the way terracotta can.

products.title: Beginner Bog Starter Kit
products.description: Everything to start a windowsill bog: a Venus flytrap, a Cape sundew, 5 L of carnivore soil, a watering tray and a printed care card. The easiest way into the hobby — and a great gift.

plant.water: Rain, distilled or RO water only. Tray method.
